verdict.rationale: Dagster provides Sensors that trigger actions on internal or external events, Schedules for cron-based automation, and Declarative Automation conditions that launch executions based on asset status/dependencies, directly matching the rule-based event-triggered action story. missing for 10: no independent/hands-on validation of these automation features beyond vendor docs, and no explicit AI-native framing of rule authoring (e.g., natural language rule creation) tying it to the 'ai-native' persona.
